_help: connection name -> { driver: "mysql"|"postgres" (SourceMod's "pgsql" also works), host, port, user, password (or "pass"), database }. Names not listed here default to a local SQLite file. e.g. "stats": { "driver": "mysql", "host": "db", "port": 3306, "user": "cs2", "password": "...", "database": "stats" }
